signals.text: Chelsea restore resilience - are they title contenders again?. Doubt crept in at Chelsea last season when they lost their Women's Super League crown - but early signs in this campaign suggest they have regained their spark for another challenge.
Barcelona monitor Chelsea's Estevao - Monday's gossip. Barcelona are monitoring Estevao, Erling Haaland attracts interests amid Man City uncertainty and Joao Felix could return to Europe, plus more.
Why are Arsenal struggling to score in WSL?. Arsenal are already playing catch-up in the WSL title race because they are struggling to score goals. BBC Sport examines why.
